question: Which feature in MS Word allows you to see a document's layout and formatting as it will appear when printed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Print Preview**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Print Preview** allows you to see a **document's layout and formatting** as it will appear when printed.
 
• This feature is crucial for ensuring that the document's layout, margins, and other formatting elements are correctly set before printing.
